suggested_issue_title: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp: the license file is only in License/, not at the repository root
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

At revision `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` the repository has no license file at its root, only `License/LICENSE.txt`.

## Environment

- Repository: aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp
- Revision: `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` (the upstream revision this report was verified against)

## Steps to reproduce

```
git ls-tree --name-only 9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2
gh api repos/aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp --jq .license
```

## Expected

A license file at the repository root (for example `LICENSE`), so GitHub license detection and package scanners, which read only the root, can identify the license.

## Actual

The only license file is `License/LICENSE.txt`; the root listing has none, so the repository page shows no license.
